expected_closure.closure_notes: Misclosure is expected due to cardinal-only call 4 (Northwestwardly) which contributes no dx/dy. True bearing from later surveys is N 33°20'00" W (see book 10989/11191 Exhibit A). With the correct bearing, misclosure would be ~0.0116 ft.

never_fabricate_call_4_bearing.description: Call 4 bearing_azimuth MUST be null — never fabricate a numerical bearing for cardinal-only directions
